description: Qwen3.5 Omni Plus is Qwen's stronger general multimodal model. We verified live support for text prompts, images, audio files, and direct video URLs on Alibaba's chat-completions-compatible API. Alibaba describes Plus as a comprehensive evolution of Qwen3 Omni with support for over 10 hours of audio input.
name: Qwen3.5 Omni Plus
